'''Liko'da''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] on the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] capital [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. He made his living by selling stims to the Sith Empires citizens.
